_about: Public-domain Martin Luther (1483-1546) in English translations printed before 1930, each translator read on the title page: First Principles of the Reformation (ed. Wace and Buchheim, 1883), Table-Talk (tr. William Hazlitt), The Epistles of St. Peter and St. Jude (tr. E. H. Gillett, 1859), clean from CCEL; Works of Martin Luther vols. 1-2 (Philadelphia: Holman, 1915-16), Lenker's Epistle Sermons vols. 2-3 (1909) and Commentary on Genesis vols. 1-2 (1904, 1910), clean from Gutenberg; and from the Internet Archive the Galatians in its 16th-century English version (London, 1839), The Bondage of the Will (tr. Henry Cole, 1823) and Lenker's Church Postil gospel sermons (5 vols, 1904-07). Works vols. 3-6 (1930-32) and every later translation are left out. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Extended 2026-10-24 by lane A at Adam's request (his Libronix list: all of Luther in public-domain English): the early English translations from 1548 to 1685 (the Kingdom of Christ, the Fifteen Psalms and Galatians commentaries, Special and Chosen Sermons, the Peter and Jude, the Liberty of a Christian, the Colloquia Mensalia), Henry Cole's Select Works, Psalms and Creation commentaries and Manual of the Psalms, the Sermons of 1830, the House-Postil and Church-Postil, the Sermons on the Passion, Luther's Letters to Women, Luther on Education, Luther's Primary Works, the Commentary on the Sermon on the Mount, Lenker's catechetical writings and further volumes, Currie's Letters, Preserved Smith's Correspondence, Conversations with Luther, the spiritual songs, and Luther's Reply to King Henry VIII. Anthologies of extracts made by others, the 'Harvard Classics' theses and machine translations are left out.
